readerCopy.headline: You have more fuel than patience.
readerCopy.body:
You may be able to move something that has been stuck for months. A difficult task feels possible. A project gains speed. You may also turn every obstacle into a dare and every disagreement into something that needs an immediate answer. The same confidence that gets you moving can make stopping feel unnecessary.

Jupiter crossing your Mars expands both courage and force. Choose one target and use the extra push there. The point is not to prove you can carry everything at once. A strong day is still followed by another day with its own work waiting.
doNotAssume: Do not assume injury, a fight, athletic success, or that more energy means unlimited physical resources.
